name: ZCTk: CustomTkinter Widget Kit
description: CustomTkinter extensions built for TODNT's GUI: a validating button, sliding toast notifications, labelled inputs and containers, an animation timer and a print() console.
highlights: Conditional button: each failed check outlines the section responsible in red, shakes the button, and lists every problem in one toast
Toast notifications slide in and stack, easing by elapsed time so animation speed doesn't depend on frame rate
Redirects print() into a text box, with carriage-return handling so progress lines update in place

media.caption: demo.py: a failed submit outlines each field that needs fixing and lists every problem in one toast; once fixed, the render is queued
